name: What structural challenges are common during cabinet installations in Denver and Aurora homes?

mainEntity.name: What structural challenges are common during cabinet installations in Denver and Aurora homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Homeowners across the Denver and Aurora metro areas often encounter shifted framing from seasonal ground movement and regional soil conditions. Homes with settling foundations or older framing frequently have walls and subfloors that are out of level. Installing cabinets in these homes requires extensive shimming, wall stud verification, and custom scribing to ensure cabinet faces and countertop mounting planes sit true. Drywall behind old cabinets often needs patching and leveling before new boxes can be securely hung.
acceptedAnswer.description: Settling soils in the Denver area often cause out-of-square walls and uneven floors, requiring shimming, scribing, and drywall leveling to hang cabinets plumb.
